input: My card was charged twice for the same order. Please fix this.
label_reason: Duplicate charge means money has already left the customer. High by the money-lost rule.

input: Payment failed three times but the amount was deducted from my account.
label_reason: Deduction without a successful order is money lost. Payment, not refund, because no refund has been requested or promised yet.

input: Which payment methods do you accept for orders above 10000?
label_reason: Pure information request about payment. Nothing is broken, so low.

input: The UPI page keeps timing out when I try to pay at checkout.
label_reason: Checkout is blocked but no money has moved. Degraded service, so medium.

input: I was charged 2499 but the product page said 1999.
label_reason: Overcharge is money lost. Payment rather than refund because the complaint is about the charge amount, not about getting money back for a returned item.

input: My EMI option is not showing up even though my bank is on your list.
label_reason: Payment feature unavailable, purchase blocked, no loss yet.

input: You took the money for an order I never confirmed.
label_reason: Unauthorised deduction. Money lost.

input: Can I pay part in wallet balance and part by card?
label_reason: Information only.

input: The invoice shows GST but I gave my company GSTIN at checkout and it is not on the bill.
label_reason: Billing document error. Real problem, but no money lost and no product issue. Judged payment because the artefact in dispute is the invoice.

input: My package has not arrived and it is nine days late.
label_reason: Long overdue shipment. Nine days past is treated as a lost parcel, not a delay, so high.

input: Tracking says delivered but nothing came to my address.
label_reason: Item marked delivered and missing means the customer paid and received nothing.

input: When will my order ship? It still says processing after two days.
label_reason: Delay only, within a normal window, nothing lost.

input: Can I change the delivery address for order 88213?
label_reason: Time sensitive request, but nothing is broken or lost. Medium rather than low because acting late makes it impossible.

input: What are your delivery charges for Dharwad?
label_reason: Information only.

input: The courier left my parcel with a neighbour without asking me.
label_reason: Delivery process complaint. The item is recoverable, so not high.

input: I got someone else's order in my box.
label_reason: Wrong shipment means the customer has paid and not received their item. Delivery rather than product_defect because the item is not faulty, it is the wrong item.

input: Delivery agent refused to come to the fourth floor and asked me to come down.
label_reason: Service quality complaint. The customer did receive the item.

input: My order was split into two shipments and only one arrived.
label_reason: Partial delivery. Second parcel is still in transit, so not yet a loss.

input: I cannot log in. It says my password is wrong but I just reset it.
label_reason: Customer is locked out. Blocked access rule makes this high.

input: How do I change the email address on my profile?
label_reason: Information request, account area.

input: I am not receiving the OTP on my registered number.
label_reason: OTP failure blocks login entirely.

input: Someone else logged into my account from Delhi last night.
label_reason: Account compromise. Security issue, always high.

input: Please delete my account and all my data.
label_reason: Account action request. Nothing is broken, but it is not merely informational either.

input: My saved addresses disappeared after the app update.
label_reason: Account data loss but the customer can still shop.

input: I want to unsubscribe from your marketing emails.
label_reason: Preference change, no impact on service.

input: My loyalty points balance shows zero but I had 4200 points last week.
label_reason: Account data problem with value attached. Not payment because no currency was charged. Medium because points are recoverable.

input: The headphones stopped working after two days.
label_reason: Product unusable. High by the unusable product rule.

input: The screen of the tablet arrived cracked.
label_reason: Item damaged and unusable on arrival.

input: The charger got very hot and there was a burning smell.
label_reason: Safety hazard. Always high.

input: The colour of the shirt is slightly different from the photo.
label_reason: Cosmetic mismatch, product still usable.

input: One of the four chair legs was missing from the box.
label_reason: Missing part makes the product unusable. Product_defect rather than delivery because the box arrived, the contents were incomplete.

input: Is this blender safe to use with hot liquids?
label_reason: Product question, nothing wrong. Product_defect is the closest category in our taxonomy for product topics.

input: The shoes are size 9 on the label but they fit like a size 7.
label_reason: Sizing error means the item cannot be used, but nothing is broken or unsafe.

input: The bottle leaked and ruined the other items in the parcel.
label_reason: Defect caused damage to other goods.

input: I returned the jacket two weeks ago and still have not got my money.
label_reason: Refund overdue. Customer has neither goods nor money.

input: How long does a refund usually take to reach my bank?
label_reason: Information only.

input: My refund came as store credit but I want it back on my card.
label_reason: Refund was issued, the form is disputed. Money is not fully lost, so medium.

input: I cancelled my order within an hour and have not been refunded.
label_reason: Cancelled order with money still held is money lost.

input: Only half of my refund amount was credited.
label_reason: Partial refund is a real loss.

input: Can I return an item after 30 days?
label_reason: Policy question.

input: The return pickup was scheduled three times and nobody came.
label_reason: Return process stuck. Judged refund because the customer's goal is the refund, not the courier visit. Genuinely contestable against delivery.

input: I was told I would get a refund on the call but nothing in writing.
label_reason: Refund promised but unconfirmed. Not yet a loss.

input: Do you have a store in Hubli?
label_reason: General company question, fits no support category.

input: I want to apply for a job in your logistics team.
label_reason: Not a support ticket at all.

input: Just wanted to say the delivery guy was very polite. Thanks.
label_reason: Positive feedback, no action needed. Not delivery because there is no delivery problem to route.

input: Are you hiring interns for summer?
label_reason: Out of support scope.

input: Your app crashes on my phone every time I open the home page.
label_reason: Technical bug with no category of its own. Deliberately kept in other to see whether the model invents a category. Not account because login is not involved.

input: Who is the CEO of your company?
label_reason: Company information, not support.

input: I did not receive the item, and I have already been charged for it.
label_reason: Two categories are present. Labelled delivery because the root cause is the missing parcel; the charge is normal and only becomes a payment issue if delivery fails permanently. This case exists to test the model's handling of mixed signals.

input: The phone I received is not defective, but it is not the model I ordered.
label_reason: Contains an explicit negation of defect. Wrong item shipped is a delivery fulfilment error. Included to test negation handling.

input: No money was deducted, but the order still shows as paid in my account.
label_reason: Negated loss. Payment status is wrong but nothing was taken, so medium not high. Tests whether the model reacts to the words money and deducted rather than the negation.

input: I am not asking for a refund, I just want the missing part sent to me.
label_reason: The word refund appears but is explicitly rejected. Missing part makes the item unusable. Tests keyword attraction against negation.
